rationale: No race telemetry exists yet. Iterations 0 and 1 were never raced because their output was cut off, so this is still a reasoned design. The timing rule (about 4 to 5 m in under 3 s) needs an average speed near 1.5 m/s, so base_speed is 1.4 (PWM base about 70% of full). Five sensors at x = -0.04 to +0.04, y = 0.04, see the line ahead of the axle, and weights -2, -1, 0, 1, 2 keep positive signal meaning steer left. kp 3.0 gives a usable correction gain; kd 0.5 damps the resulting oscillation. ki stays 0 to avoid windup on bends. line_loss 'last_direction' recovers toward the side the line was last seen. Geometry is mid-range, with body_width 0.12 keeping the off-track limit comfortable. Expected: completion on the development tracks, few line-loss events, rms_error about 0.02 to 0.035 m, and completion_time about 2.4 to 2.6 s. The main risk is slalom overshoot, which the next race should show.
